source.head: abed661f0d551f352e7a2c451d0df7fcc22bde5c
source.working_tree_vs_head: identical except 2 untracked docs (D4 review, Genesis Step-0 review)

method: Read-only static audit. Five independent reviewers (A-E), three adversarial cross-reviewers (X1-X3), lead spot-verification of every MAJOR. No FORGE code, pytest, benchmark, tool or MCP server was executed. Arithmetic derivations used stdlib-only scripts under python -I -S (no engcore importable). No finding is EXECUTED_REPRODUCED.
annexes: Full 20-field records per finding: ../reviewer_A.md .. ../reviewer_E.md; disproval attempts: ../crossreview_X1.md .. X3.md; derivation scripts: ../*.py

findings.new_or_known: NEW (PROGRESS.md:5209 BR11 accepted the '_' skip only for _concurrency/_window_control)
findings.confidence: high (source path traced by A, X1 and lead)
findings.f4_contract: replay.py:532-538 docstring ('still covered by the identity comparisons'); certification COMPUTATIONAL_REPLAY_VERIFIED gate
findings.f5_invariant: Evidence must remain bound to the exact context it was produced for; missing uncertainty never becomes zero / never improves an answer.
findings.f6_root_cause: compare_runs compares only scalar final magnitudes plus graph/plan/scenario/window/receipt identities. It never compares _uncertainty, _edge_uncertainty, _coupling_error, field outputs, output units, external inputs' uncertainty, or the replay's recomputed system validation/uncertainty/verification (built at multiphysics.py:944-1044 then discarded). external_uncertainty is a caller argument at both execution and replay and is not part of the GraphPlan identity.
findings.f7_trigger: Replay an authorized multiphysics run passing external_uncertainty=None (or different values) while inputs come from the GraphPlan.
findings.f8_expected_vs_observed: Expected: replay refuses or reports a difference when the reproduced uncertainty/validation differs. Observed (by source): REPLAYED_MATCH with a valid seal; certification UQ/validation gates read the stored record.
findings.f9_reasoning: Scalar magnitudes do not depend on the declared external uncertainty, so they match; no other comparison reads the uncertainty blocks (lead verified replay.py:556-600 identity list).
findings.f11_affected: All assembly multiphysics runs with declared input uncertainty or system UQ/validation; certification replay gate.
findings.f12_false_support_risk: medium: certification of a run's UQ/validation can rest on values the replay never reproduced. X1 showed the original trigger (code change in UQ implementation) is mostly caught by pack implementation fingerprints; the caller-uncertainty trigger needs no code change.
findings.f13_replay_provenance: Replay seal attests less than its docstring states.
findings.f14_compatibility: Comparing more blocks can turn existing REPLAYED_MATCH into differences; binding external_uncertainty into the plan moves plan digests.
findings.f15_certification: replay.py, certification.py, multiphysics.py are in current_core_v2.json -> OD-3.
findings.f18_repair: Bind declared external uncertainty into the authorized GraphPlan identity (or refuse a replay whose external_uncertainty differs), and compare _uncertainty/_edge_uncertainty/_coupling_error and recomputed system UQ/validation under the replay policy; correct the docstring.
findings.f19_owner_approval: yes: execution of R-01; certified change + OD-3; replay-policy semantic decision
findings.f20_challenge: X1: CONFIRMED with different trigger; reviewer's code-change trigger largely refuted by implementation fingerprints (compositionpacks/registry.py:87-122, domainpacks/frozen.py:39-89). Survives on caller-uncertainty path and on indirectly-imported helper/library changes.

findings.f3_location: src/engcore/system_runtime/authorities.py:206-221,:339-340,:407; system_runtime/records.py:171-187 (StateProposal has only time); system_runtime/state.py:204; system_runtime/executor.py:356-365
findings.f4_contract: SystemState.next docstring: time never runs backwards; state transitions committed from authorized runs
findings.f5_invariant: Wrong admitted numerical results must not be committed; evidence bound to the exact state it was produced from.
findings.f6_root_cause: The authority pins the plan fingerprint, so every run covers plan.time from its own start, but reads initial values from call.state and commits StateProposal(run.ended_at). Nothing compares plan start with the committed state's time; StateProposal carries no start instant.
findings.f7_trigger: Two ordered committing nodes (or one authority reused for consecutive stages) on the same owner with plan [0,10] s; or a plan [100,200] s from a state at t=0.
findings.f8_expected_vs_observed: dx/dt=1: expected x(10)=10 or refusal; observed (by source) committed x=20 at t=10. [100,200] from t=0 commits t=200 with [0,100] silently frozen.
findings.f9_reasoning: Each run integrates 10 s from the state's value but ends at plan end 10 s; state check only refuses t_new < t_old (10 >= 10 passes).
findings.f11_affected: system_runtime with MultiphysicsAuthority/MultiscaleAuthority committers; today battery_cooling.py:639 is the sole production committer.
findings.f12_false_support_risk: medium-latent: a wrong state value is committed with a valid receipt chain.
findings.f13_replay_provenance: Replays reproduce the same wrong commit; provenance looks consistent.
findings.f14_compatibility: Adding a start instant changes StateProposal schema; a preflight check is additive.
findings.f15_certification: authorities.py, state.py, records.py, executor.py certified -> OD-3.
findings.f18_repair: Preflight: refuse when plan.time.start != call.state time (exact Fraction compare in seconds); or carry start instant in StateProposal and require it to equal the state's time at commit.
findings.f19_owner_approval: yes: R-02 execution; certified change + OD-3
findings.f20_challenge: X1: CONFIRMED (latent). No authority reads the state's time (grep); two ordered committers on one owner are admissible (plan.py:262-270).

findings.confidence: high mechanism; no production InterpolationRule producer
findings.f4_contract: 'sources are not arbitrated' (properties.py exact-match branch; BR15 AUTHORITY_CRITICAL); coverage.py promises conflicts are listed
findings.f5_invariant: Caller/source choice is not evidence; contradiction requires admissible evidence (conflicts must not be silently resolved).
findings.f6_root_cause: Interpolation never checks for two point data at the same position; stable sort by position after claim_id sort makes below[-1] the largest claim_id and above[0] the smallest.
findings.f7_trigger: Two sourced data at 300 K with different values (10, 20) plus one at 400 K (30); state 350 K with an InterpolationRule.
findings.f8_expected_vs_observed: Expected UNKNOWN/refusal (as at exactly 300 K). Observed 25 (or 20 when ids swap), INTERPOLATED, status known; datum a absent from claim_digests; coverage does not list the conflict.
findings.f9_reasoning: Lead read properties.py:353-366; no coincident-position guard in PropertySet.__post_init__ or snapshot.
findings.f11_affected: spatial/fields.py:197-216 property_field, pde/cases.py:42, materials/coverage.py; not M1C.
findings.f12_false_support_risk: medium-latent: an arbitrated material coefficient is admitted as known.
findings.f13_replay_provenance: Result digest depends on claim_id spelling.
findings.f18_repair: Refuse interpolation when any bracketing position carries more than one admitted datum (return UNKNOWN with 'sources are not arbitrated'); make coverage report it.
findings.f20_challenge: X2: CONFIRMED MAJOR (latent); counter 'no producer outside tests' holds only as latency.

execution.result: Real MaterialPropertySet.resolve: 350 K gave INTERPOLATED 25.0 (ids a<b) and 20.0 (ids swapped) from the same two conflicting 300 K data; 300 K exactly gave UNKNOWN 'sources are not arbitrated'; coverage at 350 K conflicted=False. Control without coincident data: 20.0 independent of claim id.

findings.f4_contract: Tool records conditional_on independent inputs; status 'completed' interval
findings.f5_invariant: Missing uncertainty never becomes zero; UNKNOWN never improves an answer.
findings.f6_root_cause: Column c uses quantile index (i*stride_c + c) mod n with odd strides coprime to n; some column pairs are exact reverses of each other.
findings.f7_trigger: sample_count=4 with >=3 inputs (cols 1,2 r=-1); default sample_count=32 with >=17 inputs (cols 15,16 r=-1); n=32, 2 inputs r=+0.29.
findings.f8_expected_vs_observed: Expected (approximately) independent stratified inputs. Observed: Y=X1+X2 (equal widths) has sd exactly 0 and a zero-width 'completed' interval.
findings.f9_reasoning: Lead stdlib re-derivation (lead_e02_check.py): n=4,k=3 min r=-1.000000 (cols 1,2); n=32,k=17 min r=-1.000000 (cols 15,16); n=32,k=2 r=0.2903. No guard relates input count to sample_count (:39-43).
findings.f10_evidence: EXECUTED_REPRODUCED (R-04; static class before: SOURCE_PROVEN + independent derivation)
findings.f11_affected: MCP probabilistic UQ product tool; any client reading its intervals.
findings.f12_false_support_risk: medium: zero or understated uncertainty is reported to a user as a completed interval; no claim verdict consumes it.
findings.f14_compatibility: Output values change for every call; method label should change.
findings.f15_certification: mcp/probabilistic_uq.py not in current_core_v2.json; MCP layer (also O-4 layering issue).
findings.f18_repair: Use seeded scipy.stats.qmc.LatinHypercube (optionally scrambled, with recorded seed) or refuse inputs > n/2; move computation out of MCP per O-4.
findings.f20_challenge: X2: CONFIRMED, worse than reported; 'does_not_include: input correlation' disclaims physical correlation, not sampler-induced correlation.

execution.result: Real build_deterministic_samples + predictive_intervals: n=4,k=3 Y=x1+x2 and n=32,k=17 Y=x15+x16 both status=completed, lower=upper=1.0, width 0, sd 0. Control n=32,k=2 Y=x0+x1 width 1.681, sd 0.471.

findings.confidence: high mechanism; magnitude from independent simulation
findings.f4_contract: escrow.py:582-583 / PROGRESS.md:1923-1924: crediting a bracketing pair rewards an honest statement of extrapolation spread
findings.f5_invariant: UNKNOWN never improves an answer (refusal 0.5 must not become 1.0 without knowledge).
findings.f6_root_cause: Bracket test min(a,b)(1-tol) <= t <= max(a,b)(1+tol) has no bound on pair width outside the box.
findings.f7_trigger: Proposer fits in-box law L, submits A=L(1+K s), B=L/(1+K s) with s=sum((x/high)^M) or (low/x)^M built from the public card box, K~1e-4.
findings.f8_expected_vs_observed: Expected: vacuous pair is a miss. Observed (independent re-implementation, X3): hit 0.771 on INDISTINGUISHABLE worlds; expected credit +0.54 ungated, up to +0.89 with a self-check gate, vs +0.50 for honest refusal.
findings.f9_reasoning: In-box disagreement ~8e-4 < smallest sigma 0.005; outside, ratio diverges, brackets every truth, differs at 100% of outside points.
findings.f10_evidence: EXECUTED_REPRODUCED (R-05; static class before: SOURCE_PROVEN + independent simulation (not the real generator byte-for-byte))
findings.f11_affected: Genesis-lite v0.2 credit table; Blindfold escrow assessment.
findings.f12_false_support_risk: low-medium (X3): a pair hit costs -0.5 on discoverable worlds and per-kind non-inferiority blocks blanket use; pays only with a kind-separating tell (D-03, D-07, B-LEAK).
findings.f14_compatibility: Scoring change = new benchmark identity (v0.3) and certified escrow change.
findings.f16_genesis: blocks Genesis-lite Step-1 scoring freeze, Minimal Mind Step-2 gate validity, Independent Blindfold Graduation
findings.f18_repair: Add a declared outside-box width bound (e.g. max(a,b)/min(a,b) <= 1+c*tol at evaluation points, or credit scaled by bracket informativeness) in both evaluator and escrow; preregister it.
findings.f19_owner_approval: yes: OD-19 (v0.3), certified escrow change + OD-3
findings.f20_challenge: X3: CONFIRMED MAJOR, false-support lowered to low-medium.

execution.result: Real evaluator score_universe and escrow _assess_pair on a synthetic world: one vacuous pair (A/B = 1.33e30 at the region edge) scored indistinguishable_hit, credit 1.0, escrow hit=True, for BOTH mutually exclusive truths T_up and T_down. Controls: honest refusal 0.5; informative pair hit; in-box-disagreeing pair miss; vacuous pair on a discoverable world -0.5.

Scope: the capping function lift_decision calls, not the full lift_decision pipeline.
